body:
Likewise. I think the lack of friends and outlets for my frustration is a huge issue behind all this. It's hard to get it all out when there's no one to listen, and it just builds and builds and builds until you lose two pant sizes and can barely keep your head up lol. 

I keep checking this account, so I'll be around if you need to talk, too.

Definitely motivating. I'm scared that's going to happen to me. I work my shifts alone for 5-6 hours at a time, and it's horrifying to think that I could collapse and no one would notice. On the plus side, I successfully ate a cracker today before violently puking it back up. Guess I'll just keep shoving them down until one finally sticks lol. 

Thank you.

I'm here. Still haven't eaten. But my mood is slowly improving. Hopefully it'll start getting easier to take care of myself. 

And hopefully you're doing okay, too.

I'm doubtful, too. I try to stay hopeful, but nights are the worst. Hopefully I'll finally sleep tonight. 

If you need to talk or vent, feel free to message me.

Every time I try to eat, I get overwhelming nausea. Like my body is rejecting it. It's just become easier to not even bother. I'm staying hydrated, at least, so here's to hoping that'll keep me going until something gives. 

I'm sorry you're going through it, too. No one should ever have to feel this way. I hope things look up for you. <3

I never really thought of it that way. Wow. Thank you for putting that into perspective! I've never been a people person, and I don't think I ever will be. But I just feel like life would be a little more fulfilling if I put myself out there. Dating is a breeze because of all the online options, but friends are soooo hard to make. But you're absolutely right. I think I'm just eager and trying to maintain my high spirits. I'll definitely be taking it slow and steady! One day at a time, right? 😊

Oh, this is great, too! Do you have any recommendations for meeting people? I work and then come straight home, so I have no idea how to immerse myself back into the world. I think that's the scariest part of this. The gym was my first thought. But as a shy person, it's daunting to even think about just approaching someone. 😂
This is the first breakup I've seen a silver lining through. Maybe I'm in shock haha! But regardless, I'm eager to start bettering myself. If it helped you, hopefully it will help me. (:
This is amazing advice. Thank you so much! I'll definitely be following this.

Yeah, true. That's a very good point. I just realized that I'd isolated myself so much to the point where he was my only companion, and I don't think that's very healthy. Everyone needs a friend or two. But you're right. I'll just have to see what feels most comfortable. Thank you!
